title: cTuningLabs/cmeta
description: Common Meta Framework (cMeta/cX): keep code, data, models, workflows and notes as plain folders with metadata, linked by stable IDs and used through one CLI and one Python API - for collaborative & reproducible R&D, benchmarking and knowledge management that people, organizations and AI agents can share, extend and build upon. Minimal dependencies.

title: PreethiVarshaM/ai-agent-ui-standards
description: An evidence-first onboarding kit for AI coding agents. It maps existing frontend architecture, guides initial decisions for new projects, and turns agreed UI conventions into a reusable project baseline—across frameworks and agents.

title: pacoEzq/simulation-capsule
description: Simulation Capsules: CFD results distilled for large language models. Spec, example capsules, STAR-CCM+ macros and tools behind a 10-part tutorial series, plus Side Runs articles.

title: hjiang13/awesome-Large-Language-Model-4-IRs-in-Compiler
description: A curated list of research papers, datasets, tools, and benchmarks on applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to Compiler Intermediate Representations (IR) and Optimization.

title: RONAK-BHORANIYA/CampusHire
description: Built a continuously updated Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for querying training-and-placement policies, company JDs, eligibility criteria, deadlines, and placement notices through a centralized knowledge base.

title: deejay94/ragdocs
description: AI-powered developer documentation assistant using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

title: uxlfoundation/oneDNN
description: Open-source library of optimized deep learning operations (matmul, convolution, attention) for CPUs (x64, AArch64, RISC-V) and Intel GPUs. Used by PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenVINO, and ONNX Runtime.

title: guelfoweb/orbit
